fit_rationale: O09 already reserves an eligible-final-topology-segment transaction that computes the request and caps first, atomically debits local D and credits local A in the same update, and updates export ledgers exactly once. P14 can fill those clauses without adding, removing, or reordering a global operator.
transaction_order_within_o09: evaluate eligibility and the separately bound interface-active fraction for each final-topology segment at most once
read the segment-local internal-D amount and compute the exponential export request
compute all donor and interface caps before mutation
atomically commit the accepted local-D debit, local-A credit, and external host-receipt ledger credit
update requested, accepted, rejected, export, and reward ledgers exactly once

implementation_gate.reason: The existing O09 placement is complete, but the adopted P14 source does not define the interface-active fraction f_I or freeze an exact executable carbon-to-phosphorus molar conversion. This artifact does not select either missing rule.

stop_condition: Any implementation that cannot fit the existing O09 clauses must propose new exact operator-order bytes and stop for independent review before implementation or outcome execution.
claim_boundary: Technical order fit only; no interface-fraction rule, atomic-mass convention, biological value, calibration, prediction, P15 behavior, or scientific approval is selected by this artifact.
